changeSet.author: taskmanager
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE task_tags DROP CONSTRAINT fk_task_tags_task_id
ALTER TABLE tasks RENAME TO tasks_unpartitioned
CREATE TABLE tasks (LIKE tasks_unpartitioned INCLUDING DEFAULTS) PARTITION BY RANGE (created_at)
INSERT INTO tasks SELECT * FROM tasks_unpartitioned
DROP TABLE tasks_unpartitioned
ALTER TABLE tasks ADD CONSTRAINT tasks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id, created_at)
ALTER TABLE tasks ADD CONSTRAINT fk_tasks_user_id FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE tasks ADD CONSTRAINT fk_tasks_project_id FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_user_id_created_at ON tasks (user_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_created_at_due_date ON tasks (created_at DESC, due_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_project_id ON tasks (project_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_status ON tasks (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_priority ON tasks (priority)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_due_date ON tasks (due_date)
ALTER TABLE task_tags ADD COLUMN task_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
UPDATE task_tags tt SET task_created_at = t.created_at FROM tasks t WHERE t.id = tt.task_id
DELETE FROM task_tags WHERE task_created_at IS NULL
ALTER TABLE task_tags ALTER COLUMN task_created_at SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE task_tags ADD CONSTRAINT fk_task_tags_task FOREIGN KEY (task_id, task_created_at) REFERENCES tasks (id, created_at) ON DELETE CASCADE
ANALYZE tasks
ANALYZE task_tags

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE task_tags DROP CONSTRAINT fk_task_tags_task
ALTER TABLE task_tags DROP COLUMN task_created_at
ALTER TABLE tasks RENAME TO tasks_partitioned
CREATE TABLE tasks (LIKE tasks_partitioned INCLUDING DEFAULTS)
INSERT INTO tasks SELECT * FROM tasks_partitioned
ALTER TABLE tasks ADD CONSTRAINT tasks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
ALTER TABLE tasks ADD CONSTRAINT fk_tasks_user_id FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE tasks ADD CONSTRAINT fk_tasks_project_id FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_user_id_created_at ON tasks (user_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_created_at_due_date ON tasks (created_at DESC, due_date)
ALTER TABLE task_tags ADD CONSTRAINT fk_task_tags_task_id FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
